newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up slightly ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up slightly ahead of holiday.

text.p: Profit-taking by small investors on financial and pharmaceutical scrips slowed the current market rally as Dhaka stocks rose only slightly at the close of Tuesday's trading, brokers said.

Brokers, however, said floor trading was hectic ahead of Wednesday's public holiday. Volume rose sharply at 133.1 million taka against 96.7 million on Monday. The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 2.22 points or 0.17 percent at 1,239.18. Losers led gainers by 69 to 61.
Leasing stock IDLC lost 106.82 taka to 2,488.18 and Beximco Pharma fell 4.38 to 169.
